question: If x = 32, y = 33 and z = 35, then evaluate the expression x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Algebraic Identity**: x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z) × 1/2 × [(x − y)² + (y − z)² + (z − x)²]

Calculate **Sum**: 32 + 33 + 35 = 100

Calculate **Squared Differences**: (32−33)² + (33−35)² + (35−32)² = 1² + 2² + 3² = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14

Apply Trick: 100 × 14/2 = 100 × 7 = 700

**∴ The correct answer is 700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x = 32, y = 33, z = 35

**Formula Used:** x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

This can also be written as: 1/2(x + y + z)[(x − y)² + (y − z)² + (z − x)²]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d82bee9b2598ceb481a8fb1eef7b35025e350b1f88a2b69b811bbb2417979009.png] 

⇒ Sum (x + y + z) = 32 + 33 + 35 = 100

⇒ (x − y)² = (32 − 33)² = (−1)² = 1

⇒ (y − z)² = (33 − 35)² = (−2)² = 4

⇒ (z − x)² = (35 − 32)² = (3)² = 9

⇒ Value = 1/2 × 100 × (1 + 4 + 9)

⇒ Value = 50 × 14

⇒ Value = 700

**∴ The correct answer is 700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conditional Identity

If x + y + z = 0, then the expression x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = 0, which implies x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz.

Alternative Expansion

The term (x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx) can also be written using (x + y + z)² − 3(xy + yz + zx).

Arithmetic Progression Case

If x, y, z are in **Arithmetic Progression** with common difference d, then x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = 9yd² (where y is the middle term).</p
